cornerstone.holders: Electronic Channel Limited (wholly-owned subsidiary of IEIT SYSTEMS Co., Ltd.) and LUOYANG Sci-Tech Inv. (Luoyang Science Technology Innovate Group, Ltd., subscribing through QDII)
cornerstone.full_quote:
RESTRICTIONS ON DISPOSALS BY THE CORNERSTONE INVESTORS
Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the "Lock-up Period"), dispose of any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that it has purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries who will be bound by the same obligations of the respective Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: Period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date: the Listing Date (2026-09-21) is counted inside the six-month period, so the period runs from 2026-09-21 and expires at the end of the day before the six-month anniversary; the anniversary date itself (2027-03-21) is the first free day.
cornerstone.notes: Standard six-month cornerstone lock-up. Two cornerstone investors only, aggregate ~1,210,100-1,506,500 Offer Shares (8.64%-10.75% of the Global Offering). Exception: transfers to wholly-owned subsidiaries bound by the same lock-up obligations.

controller_6m.holders: Mr. SUN Yuanhao (Founder, executive Director, chairman of the Board, general manager and Core R&D Member) and Shanghai Zanxing (close associate of Mr. SUN Yuanhao) — the Warranting Shareholders / Key Persons
controller_6m.full_quote: Pursuant to Rule 18C.14(1) of the Listing Rules, each of the Key Persons has undertaken to us and the Stock Exchange that except as permitted under the Listing Rules, it/he/she will not, and will procure that the relevant registered holder(s) will not, in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of its/his/her shareholdings is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is 12 months from the Listing Date, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances ... in respect of, any of the partnership interests in its/his/her respective close associates or the securities of our Company (as applicable) that it/he/she is shown by this prospectus to be the beneficial owner.
controller_6m.basis: Not applicable: no standalone Rule 10.07(1)(a)-style six-month disposal undertaking exists. As a Chapter 18C Specialist Technology Company (dual-listed PRC issuer, Chapter 19A also applies), the 10.07(1)(a)/(b) restrictions on controlling shareholders are replaced by the Rule 18C.14 Key Persons regime, which imposes a single 12-month undertaking, and by a contractual 12-month lock-up (First Six Month Period AND Second Six Month Period) given by the Warranting Shareholders under the Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement (pages 279-280).
controller_6m.notes: Replacement regime: Rule 18C.14(1) undertaking (page 278) covers Key Persons including the controllers for 12 months from the Listing Date; Rule 18C.14(2) six-month restrictions on Pathfinder SIIs (Linzhi Lichuang, Industry Investment Fund, CICC Qizhi, CICC Haochen) are expressly disapplied (page 124). The Warranting Shareholders' underwriting lock-up spans both six-month periods, i.e. 12 months total (see controller_12m).

controller_12m.holders: Mr. SUN Yuanhao and Shanghai Zanxing (as Warranting Shareholders under the Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement; also Key Persons under Rule 18C.14(1))
controller_12m.full_quote:
(B) Undertakings by Mr. Sun and Shanghai Zanxing
Each of Mr. Sun and Shanghai Zanxing, as Warranting Shareholders, undertakes to each of our Company, the Sole Sponsor, the Sole Sponsor-Overall Coordinator, the Overall Coordinators, the Joint Global Coordinators, the Joint Bookrunners, the Joint Lead Managers, the Hong Kong Underwriters and the CMIs that, without the prior written consent of the Sole Sponsor and the Sole Sponsor-Overall Coordinator (for itself and on behalf of the other Hong Kong Underwriters) and unless in compliance with the requirements of the Listing Rules: (i) it/he will not, and will procure that the relevant registered holder(s), any nominee or trustee holding on trust for it/him and the companies controlled by it/him will not, at any time during the First Six Month Period and the Second Six Month Period, (a) sell, offer to sell, ... or otherwise transfer or dispose of or create an Encumbrance over ... any Shares or other securities of our Company or any interest therein ...; and (ii) until the expiry of the Second Six Month Period, in the event that it enters into any of the transactions specified in (i)(a), (b) or (c) ... it/he will take all reasonable steps to ensure that such a disposal will not create a disorderly or false market in the securities of our Company.
controller_12m.basis: First Six Month Period is defined as "up to and including the date falling six months after the Listing Date" (i.e. through 2027-03-21 inclusive); the Second Six Month Period is "the period of six months commencing on the date on which the First Six Month Period expires". Combined, the Warranting Shareholders are restricted for 12 months from the Listing Date, ending on (and including) 2027-09-21 — consistent with the Rule 18C.14(1) Key Persons undertaking which runs "ending on the date which is 12 months from the Listing Date". The stated end date is the last restricted day, so the first free day is the following day.
controller_12m.notes: Non-standard vs 10.07(1)(b): this is not a conditional 'cease to be controlling shareholder' test — the Warranting Shareholders gave a full unconditional 12-month contractual lock-up covering both six-month periods (only carve-outs: purchases and disposals in compliance with the Listing Rules, and pledges/charges to authorized institutions for bona fide commercial loans with notification duties, page 280). Same undertakings to be repeated in the International Underwriting Agreement (page 280). Key Persons lock-up table (pages 123-124): Mr. SUN Yuanhao 11,167,863 A Shares (8.26%), Shanghai Zanxing 7,537,589 A Shares (5.58%), Mr. LV Cheng 1,519,779 A Shares (1.12%) — all commencing on the date of the prospectus and ending on expiry of 12 months from the Listing Date.
